answer: Each identity keeps one tundra sparrow roost and locks a 70-credit zenith bond. Each epoch it files a key-signed sparrow tally taken at zenith, and an auditor recomputes it against the tundra census table; a missing tally, reused tally code, or count above capacity burns the bond. The first roost costs 36; the k-th fake roost costs 36+4(k-1), so the 1000th costs 4032 and 1000 fakes pay 2,034,000 plus 70,000 locked. A rented-roost ring fails because tally codes are key-bound and the census table exposes shared roosts. Honest keepers pay 36 once and keep the bond after a clean epoch.
